indication_area: Gaucher disease type 1 (Niemann-Pick type C outside the US)
revenue_scope: Actelion Ltd worldwide product sales of Zavesca
moa: Glucosylceramide synthase inhibitor (substrate reduction therapy, miglustat)

approval_evidence.quote: ZAVESCA (miglustat) capsules, for oral use ... Initial U.S. Approval: 2003

series_start_reason: 2011 is the earliest year in a contiguous run of Actelion full-year results releases whose text is served by a host the verifier can fetch: the FY2012 release prints FY2012 and FY2011 on a row labelled 'Zavesca sales'. Actelion printed Zavesca earlier (the FY2004 release gives 2004 CHF 6.1 million and 2003 CHF 0.7 million; the FY2008 and FY2010 releases are on MarketScreener, which returns HTTP 403 to the verifier), but no fetchable copy of the FY2009-FY2011 releases was located, so earlier years are not added.
series_end_reason: 2016 is the last year sourced. Actelion was acquired by Johnson & Johnson in June 2017; no Actelion 2017 first-quarter release was located on a fetchable host, and the J&J sales schedules (2014Q3-2026Q2) and the 2017Q2 Actelion historical sales schedule carry no Zavesca row. The series therefore stops at a sourcing boundary, not at a documented end of reporting.
annual_basis: Each year from Actelion's full-year results release for that year (CHF, Sales by product table), except 2011, which is the prior-year column of the FY2012 release; the FY2011 release itself is hosted on fiercebiotech.com, which returns HTTP 403 to the verifier. 2012 is the current-year figure of the FY2012 release, printed to one decimal (84.7); the FY2013 release's prior-year column rounds it to 85.
notes: Currency is CHF, not USD. Citations use the Yahoo Finance copies of Actelion's own GlobeNewswire releases because the canonical GlobeNewswire pages return HTTP 403 to automated fetchers (see search_log); Yahoo is a republisher, not the issuer, so the text of each release should be re-confirmed against GlobeNewswire by hand if the aggregator is not acceptable. Release dates: FY2013 11 Feb 2014, FY2014 16 Feb 2015, FY2015 9 Feb 2016, FY2016 14 Feb 2017 (canonical URL for the last: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2017/02/14/916716/0/en/actelion-announces-excellent-financial-results-for-2016.html). Restatement: the FY2014 release prints 2014 as 103 while the FY2015 release prints 2014 as 102; each year here is taken from its own release. Actelion also printed Zavesca quarterly (the FY2016 and FY2015 releases print Q4 columns), so a quarterly series exists in principle; the releases that would complete it are not on a host the verifier can fetch (see search_log). No royalty-holder source was found. The FY2012 release (14 Feb 2013) prints 2012 as 84.7 and 2011 as 68.4.
search_log: Prior attempt (exclusion): J&J sales schedules 2014Q3-2026Q2 and all J&J 10-Q/10-K/8-K exhibits 2017-2026 grepped for Zavesca/miglustat: no row. J&J 8-K/A 0000200406-17-000046 exhibit 99.1 (Actelion FY2016 statements) has no per-product revenue.
Rung 12a/12b: Actelion Ltd was a Swiss filer with no SEC filings; the quarterly press-release Sales by product table is the fullest product table it published.

Rung 12c: Web searches for UCB Zavesca royalty/miglustat returned UCB reports showing royalty income only as a total (EUR 88 million in 2025); no UCB document printing Zavesca sales was found (UCB documents were not read end to end, so this is not proof of absence). Shire and Amicus 10-K hits mention Zavesca only as a competitor.

Rung 12d: Actelion releases found via web search. Canonical GlobeNewswire pages (e.g. 2017/02/14/916716, 2005/02/24/323443) return HTTP 403 to curl with a browser and a research User-Agent; actelion.com and www1.actelion.com redirect to https://www.jnj.com/innovativemedicine/; web.archive.org connection reset through the proxy; ptacts.uspto.gov copy of the FY2014 Financial Report returns 403; takeover.ch fairness opinion (nr/3018) fetched but groups Zavesca into Other products.

Fetchable copies found at finance.yahoo.com (HTTP 200): FY2013, FY2014, FY2015, FY2016 full-year releases, plus Q1 2014, H1 2014, Q1 2015, 9M 2015, Q1 2016, 9M 2016 releases. Zavesca rows read from each FY release with an HTML parser: FY2013 96/85, FY2014 103/96, FY2015 92/102, FY2016 104/92.

Review follow-up: the FY2012 release was located at https://finance.yahoo.com/news/actelion-delivers-strong-performance-2012-060302284.html (the news.yahoo.com form of the same slug returns 404; the finance.yahoo.com form returns 200 and prints 'Zavesca sales | 84.7 | 68.4 | 24 | 24'). The earlier note that it was not found was wrong; 2012 is now a direct row and 2011 is added.

Re-tested with the verifier's own client (httpx, research User-Agent, redirects followed): globenewswire.com release pages 403; fiercebiotech.com and fiercepharma.com copies (FY2011, 9M 2013, 9M 2014, H1 2015) 403; marketscreener.com (H1 2015, FY2016) 403; ptacts.uspto.gov Actelion annual report downloads 403; finance.yahoo.com copies 200.

Quarterly build attempted and not completed: Q1 releases (2014, 2015, 2016) and the FY releases (Q4 columns) are fetchable on Yahoo, but a Yahoo copy of the half-year releases for 2015 and 2016, the 9M 2014 release, the 2012-2013 interim releases and the Q1 2017 release was not located (search for these returned only Fierce, MarketScreener or GlobeNewswire URLs), and Q2/Q3 cannot be derived without them. Fiercepharma/MarketScreener snippets print H1 2015 Zavesca 44 and 9M 2014 Zavesca 81 (9M 2013 73) but those pages are not fetchable by the verifier, so they are not cited.
UCB royalty rung (12c): web search only; no UCB document printing Zavesca net sales was found, and the UCB documents were not read end to end, so this is not proof of absence.

no_quarterly_series.source_quote: Actelion full-year 2016 results release, Sales by product - Q4 2016 table, in CHF millions, columns Q4 2016, Q4 2015, % variance in CHF, at CER, Zavesca row | 26 | 24 | 10 | 10
no_quarterly_series.details: Actelion did print Zavesca quarterly, so this is not a claim that no quarterly figure exists. The quarterly releases are hosted on GlobeNewswire, Fierce and MarketScreener (HTTP 403 to the verifier's client) and only a scattered subset has a fetchable Yahoo copy; Q2 and Q3 of 2014-2016 and every 2012-2013 interim quarter could not be sourced from a fetchable host, so an annual series is written instead (rung 12e as far as the fetchable record goes).
